stage.label: Celestial sphere. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate it, and the plus and minus keys to zoom.

hint: Drag to turn the sky; click to pick a point

pick.title: Chosen point
pick.star: {{name}}. Bright star: it appears saturated in SPHEREx.
pick.new: New field: building it takes a few minutes.

status.noWebgl: This browser could not draw the sphere. Search and the featured objects still work.
status.textureError: The sky image could not be loaded. The markers and search still work.

window.betaNote: Beta: on some phones the orientation may jump. After leaving, drag to turn the sky.
window.openHere: Open this place in the viewer
window.dragMode: The sphere still rotates by dragging.

unavailable.insecure: The sky window needs a secure connection (HTTPS).
unavailable.noOrientation: This device does not report where it is pointing.
unavailable.orientationDenied: Permission to use the orientation sensor is missing.
unavailable.noLocation: This browser does not report the location, which is needed to know which part of the sky is overhead.
unavailable.locationDenied: Location permission is missing; it is needed to know which part of the sky is overhead.
unavailable.locationFailed: The location could not be obtained.

shortcutDetail.curtain: Opens {{name}} with the curtain: visible light on one side and infrared on the other.

busy.opening: A place is opening: available once it finishes.
